sentences.text:
With the consent of both the parties, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.382,
387 and 391 of 2024 these Writ Petitions are taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.
2. These Writ Petitions have been filed challenging the impugned order vide Na.Ka.No.23455/2013/F2 (Arbit), dated 16.05.2023 passed by the first respondent and for consequential directions.

3. Heard both sides and perused the materials available on record.
4.

Since the petitioners have already got an efficacious alternative remedy under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, they are at liberty to work out their remedy in the manner known to law.
Therefore, these Writ Petitions are dismissed.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
